items.name: Shakarim Open 2023
items.information:
**Russian**

Shakarim Open 2023 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Семей.
Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 1500 тенге. 
Данные сореванования организованы командой QBERS совместно с Shakarim University.

**Қазақша**

Shakarim Open 2023 - бұл Семей қаласындағы ашық чемпионат.
Пәндердің кез келген санына қатысу ақысы - 1500 теңге.
Осы жарыс QBERS құрамасы және Shakarim Univerisity-мен ұйымдастырылады.

**English**

Shakarim Open 2023 is a competition in the city of Semey.
The base registration fee for any number of events is 1500 tenge. 
This competition is organized by the QBERS team and Shakarim University.

items.name: Colombo Cubing Christmas 2023

venue.name: Nalanda College
venue.address: Nalanda College, Siridhamma Mawatha, Colombo 10, Sri Lanka

items.information:
* Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. You can refer "Schedule" tab to see the starting time of each event.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time, please bring a valid proof of identity (**NIC/Passport/Postal ID/Driving License**)
If you still don't have any of the above mentioned identifications, bring a colour photograph of yourself certified by your school principal or a justice of peace.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for the first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session at 09:00 AM on day 1 (check [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ColomboCubingChristmas2023#competition-schedule))
* All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation.
